title: Add ČOVEČANSTVO as a Developer/Create supplemental audit visual
body:
## Summary

- Add the supplied **ČOVEČANSTVO** poster as a new **Developer/Create supplemental audit visual** inside the existing **EXTRIMLI → EXTREM → EXTRONDOL → SPAJA KOD** reflection chain; no new route, runtime module, or source-of-truth surface.
- **EXTREM authoring** — add a bounded supplemental visual entry with locked `canonicalNarrativeId`, `scenarioId`, `citation`, `visualReference`, audit-only interpretation, thematic signals, deterministic fallback, and the existing `READY | WATCH | BLOCKED` boundary.
- **Governance/public mirroring** — carry the same visual into `releaseAuditSummary.developerAndCreateRepoWideReflectionGovernance` and the SPAJA KOD audit-safe summary without changing WAWE discipline, formulas, or exposing internal interpretation.
- **Docs/downstream lock** — update the Developer/Create, EXTRIMLI, VRH, and multi-repo references so the poster remains documentation/evidence-only, preserves the **DOK/DIK/DAK/DUK/FOR** split, and keeps the equality lock intact.
- **Contract example**
  ```ts
  {
    canonicalNarrativeId: "covecanstvo-zdraviji-um-snazniji-ljudi-bolji-svet-developer-create",
    scenarioId: "covecanstvo-zdraviji-um-razumevanje-misli-empatija-humanost-developer-create",
    visualReference: "https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/81ebf11b-d1a5-451b-880a-8670fe240041",
    status: "READY"
  }
  ```

## Linked Issue / Change Driver

- Issue / ticket / rationale: Add the supplied poster as bounded Developer/Create audit/reference evidence while translating health-style language into documentation-only reflection semantics.
